messages.body_plain:
Add another data point for Mr. Williams as he indicated in the FAQ since the problem wasn't with rattle, but rather with RGtk2.

Looking more closely as I tried to install from source, the compilation was failing. I needed a different version of XCode. For me, what worked was XCode 3.2.6 from around April 2011. After installing the updated XCode, RGtk2 installed from source in R by the normal, "install.packages("RGtk2", type="source")

After that, install.packages("rattle", type="source") completed successfully and then library(rattle) followed by rattle() proved it worked.

Maybe this can help another.

Have a great day!

--Geoffrey
